# Landmark Flooring

> Landmark Flooring is a flooring store and installer in Carson City, Nevada, serving Northern Nevada. It sells and installs carpet, luxury vinyl (LVP/LVT, waterproof), laminate, hardwood and custom rugs for residential, property management and commercial customers. We use skilled installers and warranty our labor.

- Address: 2085 E William St #10, Carson City, NV 89701
- Phone: (775) 297-3236
- Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–5pm
- Licensed, bonded and insured (Nevada State Contractors Board license #0088180)
- Free estimates; financing available
